import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', sep=',')

# Group by district and sum number of dogs
district_dogs = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()

# Create bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='KreisLang', y='AnzHunde', data=district_dogs, ci=None)
plt.title('Number of Dogs per District')
plt.xlabel('District')
plt.ylabel('Total Number of Dogs')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save as PNG
plt.savefig('output.png')
